title: An alternative approach to the Painlevé paradox through constitutive characterization of constraints in impulsive Mechanics
summary: We frame the Painlevè mechanical system, which has been extensively studied because of the paradox it generates, within the class of Regular Geometric Impulsive Mechanical Systems (RGIMS), by modeling it as a mechanical system subject to a rough unilateral positional constraint $\cal{S}$, where friction is represented by an instantaneous kinetic constraint $\cal{B}$, internal to $\cal{S}$ and of impulsive nature.
